meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把杂乱难懂的代码拆解重组成清晰结构,让它更易读易改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有写乱或过时的代码想理清结构又不想改变行为
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code into a clearer structure without changing what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code feels tangled and you want cleaner structure without behavior changes

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求重构代码时,Claude 会先确认目标与范围,再建立代码依赖图、评估测试覆盖、生成分步计划,逐步执行并在每步后跑测试验证,最后做整体回归检查。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化或抽取代码时触发;若目标、范围或预期结果不明确,它会先追问具体改进点或涉及模块再动手。

say.note: 对单个文件做重构,默认模块范围、safe 策略
把范围放大到整个代码库

say.text: /refactor "所有使用废弃 API 的函数"
say.note: 按模式批量重构,先预览再应用

howto.what_en: When you ask for a refactor, Claude first confirms the goal and scope, maps dependencies, assesses test coverage, makes a step-by-step plan, executes each step and runs tests after every change, then does a final regression check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, or extract code. If the target or scope is unclear, it asks which improvement or modules you mean before starting.

say_en.note: Refactor one file; module scope, safe strategy by default
Widen the refactor to the whole codebase
